google.title: Google
google.desc: Hidden Chrome API · no key · ≤15 s

provider.hint_qwen: Qwen (DashScope): language is not sent yet — the selection is ignored
provider.hint_google_auto: Google: with "auto-detect" it actually sends en-US

google.hint: Google: up to ~15 s per recording, no key; it may stop working at any time.

validation.endpoint_url: Invalid URL — enter the full address, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1
validation.endpoint_protocol: The address must start with http:// or https://
validation.hotkey_plus: Extra "+" or an empty part — format: Cmd+Shift+Space
validation.hotkey_key: Add a regular key, e.g. Space or F12
validation.hotkey_one_key: Only one regular key; modifiers go before it
validation.hotkey_order: Modifiers must come before the key: Cmd+Shift+Space

mic.label: Microphone
mic.device_missing: ⚠ The selected device is not found right now — recording won't start until it returns or another device is chosen.

hotkey.label: Hotkey (hold to record)
hotkey.hint: Click — set, Backspace — reset to {hotkey}, Esc — cancel.

autostart.title: Launch at login
autostart.hint: VoiceDo will be available via hotkey right after macOS starts up.

stats.switch_hint: All data is stored on this device only.
stats.off: Statistics are off — new dictations are not counted.
stats.wpm_label: Your typing speed (for the savings estimate)
stats.wpm_hint: Average typing speed is about 40 words/min.

mitest.hint: Click — toggle, hold — while you hold. No text is inserted.

mic.no_device: Microphone not found — make sure the input device is connected and allowed (macOS: Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone)
mic.device_gone: Selected microphone "{name}" not found — choose another device in VoiceDo settings
mic.stream: Failed to open the recording stream: {error}
mic.unsupported_format: Microphone ({format}): unsupported format — choose another input device in VoiceDo settings (Input section)
mic.denied: No microphone access — allow it: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone (then restart VoiceDo)
mic.busy: Microphone is busy with another app — close it and try again
mic.unavailable: Microphone unavailable — check that the device is connected and selected (System Settings → Sound)

hotkey.startup_invalid: The hotkey in settings is invalid — using "{hotkey}", please fix it in the settings window
hotkey.startup_none: The hotkey in settings is invalid and the system default fails to parse — auto-recording is disabled
hotkey.register_failed: Failed to register hotkey "{hotkey}" — the combination is probably taken by another app: {error}

notify.settings_incomplete: ASR settings are not filled in — set the endpoint and token in the settings window

asr.no_speech: Speech not recognized — the recording is silent

typer.access_denied: No Accessibility permission — macOS: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility (add VoiceDo)
typer.input_denied: No keyboard input access (macOS: Privacy & Security → Accessibility): {error}

test.hotkey_busy: Hotkey recording in progress — wait for it to finish

err.auth_token: authorization error — check the token in settings
err.auth_google: Google rejected the request (unofficial rate-limited API) — try again later or switch provider
err.not_found: 404: endpoint not found — check the API address
err.no_speech_test: The server is reachable, but the test audio contains no speech
err.network: Network unavailable — the request could not be sent
err.too_long: the unofficial Google API supports recordings up to ~15 s — shorten your dictation
err.test_no_speech_ok: (endpoint responds, no speech detected — this is normal for a silence test)

hint.wav_header: could not parse the WAV header
hint.google_html_captcha: got HTML instead of JSON — probably a captcha or a Google block
hint.ndjson_parse: could not parse the NDJSON response
hint.flac_empty: FLAC encoder returned an empty result
